method: Agent-authored from the same exported four-case training packet and the public task contract, without an external synthesis service. The public held-out fixture was inspected before this authoring and is ineligible as blind efficacy evidence. This is a development-only candidate; agent authoring resources are unmetered.

discovery.evidence: Both candidate representations use the same four training inputs and public contract; unmetered agent authoring cannot be reported as zero cost. No development or held-out model results were used for selection.
